meta.title: DoA / DoFP Routing: refused for a user without the Approver role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Approver role and as an Approver on the same tenant
Verify the tenant is on the Growth or Enterprise plan
Attempt DoA/DoFP Routing as both users and compare refusal or absence versus availability
Record whether tenant RBAC grants the action to additional roles
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Approver role and as an Approver on the same tenant; Verify the tenant is on the Growth or Enterprise plan; Attempt DoA/DoFP Routing as both users and compare refusal or absence versus availability; Record whether tenant RBAC grants the action to additional roles
